  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri

        title:
          title: Title

          title: Status

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

      required:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:

          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized to E.164 form:
            spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and is the value stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Display name
              description: >-

                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rule for `POST /api/owners`: creating an owner is rejected with **409** when another owner has the same `lastName` **and** the same `address` (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace), unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

### Changes

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `sharesHousehold` property to the `OwnerFields` schema as a `writeOnly` boolean. Because it's write-only, the OpenAPI generator marks it `JsonProperty.Access.WRITE_ONLY`, so it's accepted on create input but never appears in responses (the response contract is unchanged). It's optional (not in `required`).

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — after the existing telephone-uniqueness check, added a guard that returns `409 CONFLICT` when the payload duplicates an existing household, skipped when `sharesHousehold` is true:
   - `isHouseholdDuplicate(...)` scans `findAllOwners()` and matches on normalized last name *and* address.
   - `normalizeForHousehold(...)` trims, collapses whitespace runs to a single space, and lower-cases (using `Locale.ROOT`), giving the case-insensitive/collapsed-whitespace comparison the spec requires.

The MapStruct `OwnerFieldsDto → Owner` mapping is unaffected (unmapped source property is ignored by default), and no persisted state or existing behavior changed.
